_readme: SPELL BOOK: the single source for how many leveled-spell slots each class has and which spells can sit in them.
Edit this file, then run `node tools/gen_spell_book.js`. It rewrites the GEN blocks named spell_book_* in character_progression.txt,
choicescript_stats.txt and startup_parts/02_character_profile.txt (then run `node tools/build_startup.js`). Never edit inside a generated block.
A slot is a pair of variables: <class>_spell (slot 1), <class>_spell_2 (slot 2) ... and <class>_spell_N_desc beside each.
learn_spell (character_progression.txt) puts a spell in the class's first free slot and refuses a spell already in the book.
Every spell in a slot sets held_<id> (it is in a class's book); known_<id> is held_<id> or a racial grant, and not spells_blocked.
Scenes ask held_<id> or known_<id>; they never read a slot. A new level that teaches a spell is one pick menu calling learn_spell.
classes.<name>.slots  how many slots to create. Raise it when a class needs more; run the generator and build_startup.
classes.<name>.empty  the text of a slot that holds nothing yet.
learnable             every spell id that can be in a slot. A spell that is not here cannot be learned. Adding one needs a *create known_<id> too.

wizard.empty: Your spellbook holds nothing more yet.

warlock.empty: You have bound no further spell to your pact yet.

bard.empty: You have no further verse bound to magic yet.

ranger.empty: You have learned no further working from the wild yet.
